info.title: Anndaan API
info.description: Share surplus cooked food with people and NGOs nearby.

post.description: Send a one-time code by SMS. Limited per number and per IP.
Check the code. Creates the account on first use, then returns tokens.
Swap a refresh token for a new pair. Each refresh token works once.

get.description: Food I posted. `open` = available or reserved.

schema.title: Response Unread Count Api V1 Notifications Unread Count Get

get.description:
Meals near a point, nearest first. No sign-in needed. Collected, cancelled and
expired food never appears; reserved food stays visible but cannot be reserved.
Exact addresses and coordinates are never included.

post.description: Post surplus cooked food. Requires a verified number (any signed-in user).

patch.description: Edit food that nobody has reserved yet.

post.description: Take the food off the list. Any reservation is cancelled and the collector told.
'They didn't come': end the reservation (its code stops working) and relist.
Optional food photo (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 5 MB). Re-encoded; location metadata removed.

Reserve the whole portion. Safe under concurrency: exactly one person wins, others
get 409 `listing_reserved`. Send an `idempotency_key` so a retried request returns the
same reservation (200) instead of an error.

get.description: For the donor and the collector only. The pick-up code is shown to the collector.

post.description: Door hand-over. The donor enters the 4-digit code; 5 wrong tries lock it.
Guard hand-over. The first 'Yes, collected' from either side closes the meal.
Review the other person after a completed hand-over. Once per side.

get.description: Public profile: meals shared, rating and reviews. No phone number or address.

post.description: Report unsafe food or abusive behaviour. Reviewed by the Anndaan team.

get.description: Open meal needs from verified NGOs, nearest first when a location is given.

post.description: Give meals for one date. Counted straight away; no accept/reject step.

get.description: For the donor who gave, and the NGO that receives.

post.description: Register an NGO. It stays 'pending' until the Anndaan team checks the ID and certificate.

patch.description: Fix details after a rejection. Changing details sends the NGO back for checking.

post.description: Registration certificate: PDF or photo, up to 5 MB. Only admins and the NGO can see it.

get.description: Meals donors have promised to this NGO (its donation history when upcoming=false).

post.description: Suspend: blocks sign-in and every API call, ends sessions, and takes their open food off the list.

get.description: All reservations. Use status=completed for collection records.
